kwargs.prompt: are we porting all spotify metadata to phi to add to our metadata acquastion
kwargs.thinking: Checked phi.meta Spotify client, bulk enrich, enrich_daemon, consensus, library JSON sidecars, and pipeline TrackInfo. Question is architecture: wholesale Spotify dump vs Spotify as one acquisition arm.
kwargs.outcome: Not a full Spotify dump. Spotify is one enricher among AcoustID/MB, Last.fm, Discogs, Deezer. Enrichment writes a selected subset (id, popularity, ISRC, preview, audio features when available) into ~/.phi/meta.db. Playlist sync sidecars are thinner. Audio-features endpoint often 403 for post-Nov 2024 apps.
